title: Chapter 624
text:
The Strategic Support Style was known for its powerful off-field firepower. Han Xiao especially liked this kind of fighting style. In the past two years, he had replenished the number of Satellite Orbital Cannons and placed them in the storage of the BlackLight Stealth at all times. It could be said to be a must-have weapon for traveling and killing.

The blazing mushroom cloud continued to expand and rise, creating a huge crater in the ground.

Han Xiao did not waste any time. The mechanical suit's thrusters spat out, and he led the charge into the explosion zone, heading straight for the bottom of the crater.

The combat information showed the damage caused by this round of attacks. Shana had continuously strengthened her magnetic field shield, which reduced most of the damage. Furthermore, with her equipment's defense and personal resistance, this round of attacks was not enough to heavily injure her. Furthermore, with dozens of Orbital Cannons fired at the same time, the attack power was naturally not concentrated enough, wasting a lot of power.

The biggest effect of this attack was to temporarily turn the situation around and interrupt the enemy's control. Han Xiao did not plan to give Shana any time to catch her breath. He immediately chased after her. Shana and her shield were blasted into the ground, and a hemispherical magnetic field shield was exposed at the bottom of the crater. It was very eye-catching in the flames and dust.

Boom!

At this time, Shana suddenly raised her head. Her mask had already been shattered, revealing a face with a twisted expression. A stream of blood flowed down her forehead, and her eyes were filled with murderous intent. It was as if she had already expected Han Xiao to chase after her. She pressed her palm on the ground, and a fountain of metal particles shot out from the ground below Han Xiao, grabbing toward Han Xiao.

Grade A Supers were all very experienced. The moment she was hit by the Orbital Cannons, Shana had already guessed what Han Xiao was going to do next. While resisting the attack, she had also set up a trap and gathered the metal particles around her. This was all to catch Black Star, who was flying around like a fly.

However, the next moment, Han Xiao's figure suddenly disappeared.

Hu!

Less than a meter behind her, she suddenly felt a gust of wind. Her sharp senses told her that there was one more person in the magnetic field shield.

Race Talent — Advanced Void Travel!

"How did he break through the magnetic field shield?" Shana's expression changed drastically. Before she could turn around, the back of her head was grabbed by a large hand wrapped in a bone-white mech. An irresistible force exploded, and with a bang, she was pressed face down into the ground.

In the next second, the grey light of void energy flowed out of the Void Dragon Mechanical Suit and gathered on its arm.

Full power Void Jet!

Boom boom boom —

Void Jet could attack continuously without any cooldown, but the price was that the energy consumption would increase continuously. Han Xiao did not hold back at all and used up almost all of the Void Dragon's remaining energy.

After the first shot, he activated the injection module in the mecha and injected a gene agent. In the past two years, he had captured countless space pirates. His private prison had been renamed as the "Space Pirates' Warm Hut". He had collected a large number of genetic agents that could adapt to any situation. This agent gave the character a temporary ability that made it easier to stun.

The consecutive shots of Void Jet directly triggered this effect, and Shana entered a stun state. Her mind was in a mess, and she could not resist at all. Thus, she could only obediently take on Han Xiao's storm-like attacks and let him do whatever he wanted. Her body was trembling non-stop from the explosions.

After the last shot, Shana was still in a stun state and could not use her ability. Han Xiao did not say anything and directly switched to the Berserk Ape, entering a state of lightning overload!

He raised his arms high, and the dazzling lightning energy gathered in his fists.

In the next instant, his fists smashed down!

Bang!

The lightning exploded like a spider web, and the bottom of the crater was filled with cracks again. A loud explosion sounded!

Han Xiao went all out in this attack. With the [Power Explosion] of the Berserk Ape, his [Gene Liberation], and the critical hits that were occasionally triggered while Shana was in a stun state, the damage multiplier was more than ten times.

Crack!

Even with the deafening sound of the collision, Han Xiao could clearly hear the sound of Shana's bones breaking.

Han Xiao's face was calm, and he did not use any tricks. He grabbed Shana's neck, took a lunge, turned around, and threw Shana out like a softball. The moment she left his hand, a circular shockwave exploded in the air.

Berserk Throw!

Hu!

Shana flew out like a cannonball, instantly flying out of the area covered by the mushroom cloud. The distance between them increased, and she almost disappeared from sight.

However, this was not the end of the combo!

Shana flew far away, and just as she was about to recover from the stun state, dozens of stars lit up in the sky.

The second round of Orbital Volley!

Boom!

The second mushroom cloud rose slowly.

The shockwave arrived as expected. Han Xiao's mechanical suit on his legs transformed into a foundation, firmly stabilizing his body, and he was not blown out.

Han Xiao waved his hand, and a huge square gun appeared beside his feet. It looked like a big box, two meters tall, and there were more than twenty nozzles at the top of the box. This was a grenade launcher. He carried it on one shoulder and fired at the center of the second mushroom cloud in the distance.

Bang bang bang!

Countless specially-made grenade missiles were shot out of the box with flames trailing behind them. They flew in a parabola, crossed a long distance, and hit the target, causing a series of violent explosions.

The grenade missiles were all small-yield nuclear grenades and Space Distortion Bombs, and the magazines were quickly emptied.

In the distance, Gadeli finally rescued Jayne from the metal ball.

The two of them looked at this scene and swallowed their saliva.

This is too cruel. This is practically a massacre …

After emptying his magazine, this combo had dealt tons of damage. However, there was still no kill notification, which meant that Shana was still alive. As a Super who was close to A +, her resistance to attacks was also very strong. Han Xiao switched to Void Dragon again and consumed some energy to recover some of the mechanical suit's energy.

Just as he was about to follow up with another attack, Shana's figure suddenly rushed out of the mushroom cloud. She soared into the sky at high speed, and all the giant metal snakes followed closely behind. They merged together like a lone mountain rising from the ground.

"She's escaping? No! She's going to dismantle my satellite railgun. "

Han Xiao's eyes focused, activated the launcher, and chased after her.

The two of them headed straight for outer space, one after the other.

"Damn it …" Shana glanced at Han Xiao, who was chasing after her, and gritted her teeth.

She had taken a series of explosive attacks and suffered the most damage from the stun state. She was severely injured. Her left arm was limp, and the bones in her arm were broken into abstract art. Her left leg was also twisted abnormally, and the left side of her body was severely damaged by Han Xiao. She did not know how many ribs were still connected, but her chest and back were burning with pain. She was in a very bad state.

It had been a long time since she had been injured like this. She was shocked and angry at this moment. She was shocked by Black Star's sudden burst of firepower, and angry that she was severely injured.

"If only Eliot was here …" Shana could not help but think of her Mage partner. She secretly regretted acting alone. She had been too careless this time.

Although she was severely injured, Shana had no intention of retreating in her anger. She was going to dismantle all of Black Star's firepower support in outer space. This way, the battle could still be fought.

In Han Xiao's vision, the surface of the earth was shrinking rapidly. The two of them charged into the sky, and he controlled all of the Eyes of God to aim at Shana. He took turns to shoot at her, wanting to slow her down.

However, Shana was prepared. Her flight path was irregular, and she never flew in a straight line. At the same time, she used the gigantic metal snake as a shield, blocking or dodging all of the railgun shots.

Looks like I can't stop her … Han Xiao calmly judged. Without any hesitation, he activated the recovery system of all the satellite cannons, and the Eyes of God flew back to the Blacklight Stealth's warehouse. He was going to let Risda take the weapons and leave the battlefield again. With the mobility of the Blacklight Stealth, Shana was helpless.

The two of them finally approached the edge of the atmosphere. In front of them was the pitch-black environment of the universe. The Blacklight Stealth had already recovered all of its satellite cannons and was leaving this planet.

Shana gritted her teeth and raised her right arm with difficulty, about to activate her Esper ability.

Han Xiao's Advanced Void Travel had not finished its cooldown yet. Just as he was about to fire another Void Jet at Shana, a beam of light suddenly shot out from the surface and accurately hit Shana. This time, she was not prepared and was sent flying, tumbling in the sky.

On the ground, Gadeli was operating a super-large rail sniper cannon with both hands. He was the one who had fired that shot. As a gunner, he had brought along guns that could adapt to various situations. This huge gun was specifically used for rail sniping.

Gadeli was a Grade A Gun Mechanic. Although he was beaten up by Shana due to her ability being countered, it was not that he did not shine. When sniping a target in outer space, one had to consider parameters such as the rotation speed of the target. However, at his level, this was a normal operation. As long as the gun's performance was good enough, his sniping range was extremely high.

This interrupted Shana's ability. The Blacklight Stealth accelerated and escaped from Shana's ability range.

Shana barely stabilized her body and floated in the air. She stared at Han Xiao and felt that the situation had become extremely troublesome.

In her current state, the chances of capturing and defeating the three Calamity Grades, including Black Star, were extremely slim. Shana immediately had thoughts of retreating.

Shana did not want to gamble her life on something that she was not confident about. There was no need for that. Even if she failed, it would be the same the next time she brought her companions. Her failure this time would at most alert the enemy.

However, in her opinion, even if Black Star was vigilant, it would be useless. She did not reveal any information, so Black Star had no idea who was targeting him.

Next time, as long as she brought along powerful companions, under overwhelming combat power, regardless of whether Black Star was prepared or not, he would still be defeated.

Thinking of this, Shana's anger subsided. She regained her calmness and took this loss.

She did not want to waste any more time. With a wave of her hand, the giant metal snake pounced toward Han Xiao. Then, she summoned a single-person spaceship and quickly sat in the cockpit.

Han Xiao was entangled with the giant metal snake and could not chase after her. He also did not think of chasing after her. The Void Dragon mechanical suit could not outrun the spaceship, and the Berserk Ape would be restrained. It was indeed very difficult for him to keep Shana here.

Most importantly, although Shana was a rare opponent, Han Xiao did not want to kill her here.

Shana's spaceship quickly left. Before entering the hyperdrive, Han Xiao threw an Observer's Mark at Shana.

Without Shana's control, the giant metal snake instantly collapsed and fell to the ground like rain.

Han Xiao floated in the air and looked at the light trail left behind by Shana's spaceship. He smirked.

"Treating me as prey is not that easy …"

The mysterious organization that Shana belonged to had their eyes on him. Even if he killed Shana, there would still be powerful enemies coming to kill him in the future. This was only a temporary solution.

Currently, Han Xiao knew nothing about this mysterious organization. He urgently needed information.

The Observer's Mark was the best ability to steal information. Han Xiao wanted to let Shana go because he wanted to cast a long line to catch a big fish.

The key to his mission was to figure out the background and scale of this mysterious organization and find their base. After all, there was no such thing as guarding against thieves for a thousand days. Han Xiao did not want to live in fear of being ambushed at any moment.

This mysterious organization was a ticking time bomb. If he wanted to get rid of it once and for all, this was the most efficient way.

Although he would still have to face Shana, who countered him, in the future, Han Xiao decided to change the focus of his machinery manufacturing during this period. He started to build non-metallic machines on a large scale, as well as special machines that could be controlled by magnetic fields. This would reduce Shana's ability to counter him to the greatest extent.

As long as he gave the Mechanic class time to prepare, he would be able to create any counter.

"However, this woman is quite strong. If I didn't have two helpers, I would have a hard time fighting her."

Han Xiao sighed. If it was a one on one battle, he had the ability to switch between health and energy, so the battle would become a battle of attrition. The chances of Shana defeating him would be extremely low. However, with just his tankiness, he would have a hard time. Luckily, he had two helpers, Jayne and Gadeli, to share the firepower.

After defeating Shana, the first round of the Hidden Grade A Chain Mission [Prey] popped up, and he received more than thirty million experience. Han Xiao did not immediately draw Shana's ability. Without Fu Ding by his side, he was not confident.

"I'll draw it when I return to the base …" Han Xiao shook his head helplessly.
